What AfroBot does

AfroBot is hands-on robotics and AI for children in Cameroon and the United States. Classes in Cameroon began in November 2022. A pilot in McKinney, Texas, followed in 2024.

Programs by age

Discover

Ages 6–9. Hands-on building, with an adult close by.

Discover

Build

Ages 9–12. A longer project: design something, make it, and test it.

Build

Teen track

Ages 13–17. Innovate, Compete, and Advance.

See the programs
Cameroon since 2022 Holiday programs in Bamenda, and classes that are still running. McKinney, Texas, 2024 About 30 kids. Five to six teams. Parents were in the room.

Proposed

2027 Plan

The 2027 season in Dallas–Fort Worth scales the 2024 pilot to about 15 teams and about 90 students. Teams build small humanoid robots from open-source schematics and 3D-printed parts. AfroBot is also hosting a Yaoundé event on a separate date.

  1. Season kickoff

    August 2027

  2. Washington DC and Maryland

    2027

  3. Atlanta

    2027

  4. Houston

    2027

  5. Dallas–Fort Worth

    2027

  6. National championship

    Dallas, April 2028
